summary_for_children: Az-Zukhruf means Gold Ornaments. It reminds us that Allah made the earth a bed for us with roads, sends rain in measure, and gave us ships and animals to ride, and that gold and silver are small next to faith.
world_title: Roads Across the Bed of Earth
environment_concept: Roads across the earth (43:10), rain in measure reviving dead land (43:11), and ships and animals to ride (43:12).

story_library.title: The City of Gold
story_library.children_narration: Imagine a city filled with beautiful ornaments, golden decorations, and impressive buildings. Does having all those things make someone good or wise? Surah Az-Zukhruf reminds us that wealth and beauty are not the true measure of a person's worth. It also recalls the stories of Musa and Isa.

world_idea.title: The Golden City
world_idea.description: Explore an ornate city and learn to distinguish luxury from kindness, honesty, and sincere faith through interactive choices.
